seoTitle: Breadcrumb Trail Builder: HTML and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
metaDescription: Turn a URL path into breadcrumb navigation HTML and matching BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. Rename any level. Free.
intro: Builds a breadcrumb nav and the JSON-LD from a URL.
why:
Breadcrumbs help visitors and can appear in search results when marked up. The visible trail and the markup must match.

The names come from the URL segments, so check them and rename the ones that are not right. The last item is the current page and does not need a link or an item URL.

faq.a: Not by default; the current page is marked with aria-current.
It follows the schema.org BreadcrumbList shape. Test it in a rich results tool.

faq.q: Do names come from page titles?

faq.a: Edit the URL or paste the output and adjust.
